goal: WASM round 2: enums land on wasm. Gate: bash spec/wasm-acceptance.sh (now 9 probes incl. p7 enums, p8 Option/Result; p1-p6+p9 already pass).
ordering: Top-to-bottom. Bank a win per iteration. Never regress native backends, the cargo suite, or already-passing probes. NEVER edit probes/.expect files.

features.contract: Lower enums for wasm as tagged slot records reusing the struct slot-encoding that landed last night (tag word + payload slots, like the native i64-slot layout). Cover: variant construction (bare Circle(2) and qualified Shape.Empty), match with payload binding (Circle(r) => ...), multi-field payloads (Rect(w,h)), nullary variants. The match-on-tag lowering can reuse the scalar Switch lowering from last night.

Make std Option/Result work on wasm: generic enum instantiation (Option___i64 / Result___i64_str monomorphs arrive in MIR like normal enums -- if 'enums' above is general this may be nearly free), Some/Ok/Err/None construction through fn returns, match with payload binding incl. str payloads (err arm concatenates 'err ' + e). Also exercises early return.
